name: WorkflowDone 404 Monitor
author: workflowdone

sections.description:
WorkflowDone 404 Monitor helps you keep your WordPress site healthy by automatically detecting 404 errors and broken links.

Features

  • Daily Automatic Scanning – Your site is scanned daily for 404 errors
  • Base Index System – Monitor only the URLs you care about
  • New URL Detection – Automatically discovers new pages and posts
  • Redirect Detection – Identifies URLs that redirect (301/302) and shows destinations
  • Resolve Workflow – Mark issues as resolved to track your progress
  • Email Notifications – Get notified when 404 errors are detected
  • History Log – Complete audit trail of all changes

How It Works

  1. Upon activation, the plugin creates a “base index” of all your existing URLs
  2. Daily scans check all base URLs for 404 errors
  3. New URLs are automatically detected and can be added to monitoring
  4. Email notifications alert you when issues are found
  5. Use the resolve feature to track which issues you’ve fixed

Supporter Version

  • Slack notifications
  • Discord notifications
  • Telegram notifications
  • Custom webhooks (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • Excel export with color-coded reports
  • Daily digest summary
  • Priority support

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘404 Monitor’ in your admin menu
  4. Configure email notifications in Settings
  5. Click ‘Run Scan’ to start monitoring
sections.faq:
How often does the plugin scan for 404 errors?

The plugin runs an automatic scan once per day. You can also manually trigger a scan at any time from the dashboard.

What happens when a 404 is detected?

If email notifications are enabled, you’ll receive an email with details about the broken link. The 404 error will also appear in your dashboard.

What does “Resolve” do?

Marking a URL as resolved removes it from the base index and stops notifications. Use this for URLs you’ve intentionally removed or redirected.

Can I export my 404 data?

Excel export is available in the Supporter version of the plugin.
